promoted.description: Promoted PyMC model (bedroom-group time curves + per-building half-year random walk), NUTS 4x1000/1000; screen fits on each split's training rows
promoted.feature_set: promoted model's own design (bayesian_structure_graph_v2 defaults + building walk)

units.note: nuts-hwalk-units, unit effect integrated by 200 MC draws

promoted.fit_seconds_note: full production fit of the promoted structure model: ~6.2 h local wall time (protocol 22:28 -> posterior 04:38, 4 chains x 4000 tune + 6000 draws, shared machine); its row-split held-out screen took 9,697 s
promoted.cost_note: estimate: 6.2 h at the Modal 4-core CPU rate ($0.32/h); the older spline model's measured Modal fit was 55 min, $0.38

footer: Each hardware class has its own table, frontier and best: a fit time only competes with fit times on the same hardware (where the fit ran). Modal H100/H200 times are not comparable with thelio's.

The custom Gibbs sampler (line `frontier`, sampler `gibbs`) is deprecated since 2026-09-25 (Ben): its entries stay as history and are not used for new work; new fits use library samplers (NumPyro NUTS, line `numpyro`).

annotations: Fit on a Modal H100 (NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3): 16 chains x (900 warmup + 2,000 draws), 3,368 s including JIT (warmup 851 s, sampling 2,515 s), about $4.11. Gate: max split R-hat 1.006, min bulk ESS 2,573, all-effects R-hat 1.02 from exact per-chain moments.

Not refit locally (Ben, 2026-09-24): the design and its settings were tuned for an H100, and thelio's RTX 2060 runs float64 at about 1/32 rate. Its fit time on this board is H100 time; the thelio fit time is unmeasured, so it is not the local baseline for fit-time work.

Chosen to serve the app (Ben, 2026-09-24): the rows-split fit m8-drift-desc-v1-rows-b7c196f, through the summary-output reader. Its posterior uses 47,374 of 52,638 rows (the 5,264 row-split held-out rows are predicted, not fit). No all-rows m8 fit exists.

Sampler check: the Gibbs-vs-NUTS agreement test for the drift design (tdrift) passes against the non-centred reference (unit_drift_scale sd ratio 0.98-1.05 over two seeds; PR #17 review). The old xfail came from a centred reference. The margin is thin (Gibbs ESS on unit_drift_scale about 80-200 in the test).

units split rescored from 320 kept draws with the exact unseen-unit quadrature (rentfrontier.rescore @ce6db1c): exact - recorded approximation = +4.2 ± 1.5 on the same draws (5,226 unseen-unit rows), so the recorded +932.7 is about +936.9 under exact scoring.
